celebration.title: Labor Thanksgiving Day
celebration.description:
Labor Thanksgiving Day  is an annual public holiday in Japan celebrated on November 23 of each year, unless that day falls on a Sunday, in which case the holiday is moved to Monday.
The law establishing the holiday cites it as an occasion to respect labor, to celebrate production, and for citizens to give each other thanks.
